summary: mvn -q verify exits 1: 5 test errors from two root causes — request-scope proxy missing (MemberRegistrationServiceTest) and Flyway/Hibernate sequence mismatch (MemberRepositoryTest x4)
MemberListModel is @RequestScope but injected into singleton MemberController without a scoped proxy; @SpringBootTest context load fails with ScopeNotActiveException

V1 Flyway migration uses IDENTITY column, not a sequence; Hibernate 6 @GeneratedValue (strategy=SEQUENCE by default) expects aa_registrant_seq; ddl-auto=validate causes @DataJpaTest context to fail with SchemaManagementException

logback-spring.xml absent from src/main/resources/ — target-architecture §6 prescribes it as the mandatory replacement for log4j.xml (old log4j.xml in each WAR → logback-spring.xml in src/main/resources/)

MemberController.configKey uses @Value field injection (private String configKey) instead of constructor injection — Spring idiom requires all injection to go through the constructor; @Value parameter should be moved to the constructor signature
